User confirmation is not clinician approval. This applies to the stated component only, not the entire metric or overall health. One in-target result does not establish stability. Do not change medication based on this target.
Changing a target requires review of existing actions and reminders. Previous targets and decisions remain in the encrypted history.
Target needs review: the report or context changed, or its original confirmation basis is unavailable.

Stop using this target and return to reassessment. Related reminders will be cancelled and actions will require review; records and target history are retained.
